prompts.lightning:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: production transparent walk animation sprite sheet for a soft-realistic animal ranch. Input image 1 is the edit target: existing white lop rabbit sprite sheet, four columns and two rows. Keep the same rabbit identity, floppy lop ears, realistic eyes, anatomy, camera angle facing right, warm upper-left outdoor light, furry detail, eight separate full-body poses and exact rigid 4-column by 2-row composition. Top row ADULT rabbits; bottom row visibly distinct BABY rabbits, NOT scaled adults. Four consecutive walking phases per row with genuinely alternating paws. Change only the elemental appearance described below, making it part of the animal design rather than a generic painted ring. Clean true alpha background. Keep the whole rabbit and all elemental detail entirely inside each cell with 16% empty transparent margins, no overlap between cells, all feet consistent at 80% of each cell height. No scene, ground patch, baked shadow, lettering, numbers, grid lines, checkerboard drawn into pixels, outline sticker or border. Soft realistic cozy game art, elemental effects visible at small game sizes but retain readable fur, face and anatomy. Do not crop ears, feet, tails or effects.
LIGHTNING variant: pearly white fur with natural soft lavender/silver accents along ear edges and spine; 2 to 3 organic forked electric arcs curling close to the fur and between ear tips, small electric sparks visibly illuminating the fur. Bright pale violet and blue-white arcs with a soft natural falloff on transparent alpha, modest glow that does not obscure eyes. No lightning ground ring, no round orbit dots, no costume, no wings. Same style on adult and baby, baby proportion genuinely smaller and rounder.
